{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: List overdue invoices over $1,000.", "sql": "SELECT i.invoice_id, c.company_name, i.invoice_date, i.amount
FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
WHERE i.status = 'overdue' AND i.amount > 1000
ORDER BY i.amount DESC"}
